_comment: Manual license overrides for artifacts with missing/ambiguous POM data (E1.I7)
_instructions: Add entries for artifacts where the POM license is unclear or missing. Each entry must have: license (SPDX), reason (why this mapping), source_url (where license was verified).

org.example:example-lib.reason: Verified from GitHub repository license file

com.google.guava:listenablefuture:1.0.reason: listenablefuture:1.0 is Guava's empty placeholder artifact (published to avoid guava/guava-android classpath conflicts); its POM declares no <licenses> block. It ships no code of its own and is covered by Guava's own Apache-2.0 license.
